question: Should OpenClaw permanently reserve the top-level `auth` CLI root even when an installed plugin already owns that command group?
rationale: This changes ownership of a plugin-facing namespace, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish whether existing plugin commands may be displaced.

options.title: Keep plugin ownership
options.body: Retain `openclaw models auth list` as the canonical command and do not reserve the generic root name.

options.title: Reserve auth in core
options.body: Approve the core namespace only with an explicit compatibility policy, migration guidance, and collision proof.

recommendation.title: Keep plugin ownership
recommendation.body: Retain `openclaw models auth list` as the canonical command and do not reserve the generic root name.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CLI startup and routing work makes this the strongest available owner signal for the namespace decision.
